title: Keyless CloudWatch logging with redaction
description:
Purpose: Standardize Plexus CloudWatch logging so application logs and metrics use IAM role/default AWS credentials and CloudWatch log shipping is gated by app-side redaction plus CloudWatch data protection policy.

Definition of Done:
- CloudWatch clients used by Plexus logging utilities do not pass static AWS access keys.
- CloudWatch application logging fails closed unless redaction and data protection policy setup are active.
- Existing public imports remain compatible.
- Unit tests cover keyless clients and redaction behavior.
